# Readability

`Readability.js` and `Readability-readerable.js` from
<https://github.com/mozilla/readability>, version 0.6.0 (commit
`ab4027a8b37669745016869a37a504727992b2ba`), unchanged.
Copyright (c) 2010 Arc90 Inc. Apache License, version 2.0, see `LICENSE.md`.

Foss Explorer uses them for *Settings > Accessibility > Simplified view for
web pages*: `Readability-readerable.js` tells whether a page looks like an
article, `Readability.js` takes the article out of it. The app carries the
same two files as `app/src/main/assets/reader/`; a test compares them with
the ones here.
